spans.s: 1. गुप् cl. 4. P. ˚प्यति (p. Ā. गुप्यमान, in Prākṛt guppam˚ Jain.), to become perplexed or confused, Dhātup. xxvi, 123.

2. गुप् (for pr. &c. See गोपय & ˚पाय, from which the root is derived [cf. Pāṇ. iii, 1, 28 & 31]; perf. जुगोप, MBh. &c.; 3. pl. जुगुपुर्, RV. vii, 103, 9; AV. &c.; fut. 2nd गोप्स्यति, AV.; ŚBr. vi &c.; fut. 1st गोप्ता or गोपिता, Pāṇ. vii, 2, 44; aor. अगौप्सीत् or अगोपीत्, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 50, Kāś.)
to guard, defend, protect, preserve (from abl.), RV. vii, 103, 9; AV. &c.;
to hide, conceal, Śiś. xvi, 30 (inf. गोपितुम्) :
Caus. गोपयति &c. See ss.vv. गोपय and ˚पाय:
Desid. Ā. जुगुप्सते (Pāṇ. iii, 1, 5; ep. also P. ˚ति)
to seek to defend one's self from (abl.), be on one's guard (cf. i, 4, 24,
Vārtt. 1
Vārtt. 15
, Pat.; vi, 1, 9, Kāś.
3. गुप् mfn. ifc. ‘defending, protecting’, see धर्म-
being on one's guard or preserving one's self from, Naiṣ. vi, 66.
protected, guarded, RV. x, 85, 4 and 109, 3; AV. ii, 28, 4; x, 10, 4; xviii, 4, 70.
‘a protector’, king, Uṇ. i, 57.
protected, guarded, preserved, AV. &c.
hidden, concealed, kept secret, secret, Bhartṛ.; Pañcat.; Kathās. &c. (with दण्ड, a secret fine, fine secretly imposed or exacted, Hit.; cf. गूढ-द्˚)
= संगत (? joined, combined), W.

(अस्), m. (Pāṇ. vi, 1, 205, Kāś.) N. of several men belonging to the Vaiśya caste (PārGṛ. i, 17; cf. RTL. p. 358), especially of the founder of the renowned Gupta dynasty in which the names of the sovereigns generally end in गुप्त (cf. चन्द्र-, समुद्र-, स्कन्द-; गुप्त is also often found ifc. in names of the Vaiśya class)
the era named after the Gupta dynasty (beginning, A.
; hence the Gupta year 165 corresponds to, A.
-85; in later times the years are called वलभी-संवत् from the rulers of Valabhi, and the era is spoken of as the Gupta-Valabhi era).
(आ), f. a married woman who withdraws from her lover's endearments, L.
Mucuna pruritus, Suśr. iv, 26, 33; vi, 46, 21 (˚प्त)
N. of a woman, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 121, Sch. (गोपा, Kāś.)
of a Śākya princess, Buddh.
(in comp. अ-, Hcat.) secretly, privately, Kathās.
(सु-), Pañcat. iv
(ए), ind. in a hidden place, Kathās. lxxv
गुप्त—कथा f. a confidential communication, W.
गुप्त—गति m. ‘going secretly’, a spy, L.
गुप्त—गृह n. ‘secret room’, bed-room, Gal.; Pañcad.
गुप्त—चर m. ‘going secretly’, Bala-rāma, L.
गुप्त—तम mfn. carefully guarded (as the senses), Ragh. i, 55.
गुप्त—तीर्थ n. N. of a Tīrtha, SkandaP.
गुप्त—दान n. a hidden gift, W.
गुप्त—दीक्षा-तन्त्र n. N. of a Tantra.
गुप्त—दूत m. a secret messenger, W.
गुप्त—धन n. money kept secret, Pañcat. ii, 6, 10/11
गुप्त—धन mfn. guarding one's money, ib.
गुप्त—प्रयाग m. N. of a locality, Rasik. xi, 41.
गुप्त—मणि m. a hidden place, Gal.
गुप्त—मति m. ‘hidden-minded’, N. of a merchant, HPariś. i, 269.
गुप्त—रजस्वला f. a girl who has begun to have her courses, Gal.
गुप्त—वती f. N. of a Tantra.
गुप्त—वेष m. dress used for concealment, disguise, W.
गुप्त—वेषे ind. in disguise, W.
गुप्त—शील mf(आ)n. ‘of a hidden character’, cunning (cf. शील-ग्˚.)
गुप्त—सरस्वती f. N. of a river (also called eastern Sarasvatī), KapSaṃh. xx.
गुप्त—साधन-तन्त्र n. N. of a Tantra.
गुप्त—स्नेह mf(आ)n. having a secret affection
गुप्त—स्नेहा f. ‘having the oil hidden’, Alangium hexapetalum, L.
गुप्त—स्वेद m. = -स्नेहा, Gal.
N. of a locality, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 90, Kāś. (cf. अ॑र्मन्-)
the prince Āryaka (who in youth was kept hidden), Mṛcch. vii, 2/3.
one who has secretly shaken off from himself worldly obligation (opposed to व्यक्ताव्˚).
a particular method of sitting (= सिद्धास्˚).
a preserver, W.
N. of a Sauvīraka prince, MBh. iii, 15597.
preserving, protecting, protection, AV. vi, 122, 3; xii, 3, 7; TS. v f.; TBr. &c.
restraint (of body, mind, and speech), HYog.; Sarvad. iii, 191 and 210 f.
concealing, hiding, keeping secret (ifc.), Kām. (Hit.), Sāh.; Sarvad. xv
a means of protection, fortification, rampart, R. v f.; Kum. vi, 38
a prison, VarBṛ. v, 10
‘place of concealment’, a hole in the ground, sink, cellar, L.
digging a hole in the ground, L., Sch.
‘a leak in a ship’ or ‘the well or lower deck of a boat’, L.
गुप्ति—गुप्त m. N. of a Jaina teacher
गुप्ति—पालक m. jailer, Mṛcch.
गुप्ति—बन्धम् ind. p, Pāṇ. iii, 4, 41, Sch. (not in Kāś.)
गुप्ति—वाद m. a secret conversation, L.
a jail-superintendent, VarBṛ. xii, 15.
N. of a man, Avadānaś.
(cf. स्वर-गुप्ति) depth (of voice), Divyāv. i, 372.
